title: How to Choose a Business Niche Using Three Practical Starting Questions
description: A useful business niche sits where your experience, a real problem and a possible product overlap. Start with three questions: what can you explain clearly, what do people already ask for, and what could you make to help? Write the overlap as one person in one situation.
